title: Remove or wire up the unused heritage_navy color resource in android colors.xml
why: No `@color/heritage_navy` reference exists anywhere under learning_tracker/android/ (checked all res/*.xml and Kotlin sources) — the resource is dead. The same navy (0xFF0038A8) is the app's real brand color, hand-duplicated as raw Color(0x..0038A8) literals across several Dart theme widgets instead. The Android resource is a third, disconnected copy nothing reads; if the brand color ever changes, it silently goes stale with no build warning and no consumer to notice or break.
recommendation: Delete the unused resource, or if it's meant to back a native notification-icon tint or similar, wire it up and reference it from the relevant native/Dart code (or leave a comment documenting why a native-only copy must exist).
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn "heritage_navy" learning_tracker/android/ returns either zero results (removed) or at least one real consumer (wired up).
